name: BirdyChat
description:
Connect Claude to your BirdyChat workspace. Read, send, and manage messages, threads, and channels without leaving the conversation

- Send and reply to messages, including scheduled messages
- Create and manage threads (one-on-one and group)
- Organize your inbox with channels, archiving, and snoozing
- Add or remove thread members and manage roles
- Upload file attachments
- React to messages

_published_faq.name: How do I add BirdyChat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BirdyChat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://birdy.chat/api/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BirdyChat MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BirdyChat lists 35 MCP tools, including birdychat_attachments_create, birdychat_capabilities_thread_types, birdychat_channels_create, birdychat_channels_delete, birdychat_channels_get, birdychat_channels_list, birdychat_channels_update, birdychat_messages_create, birdychat_messages_delete, birdychat_messages_get, birdychat_messages_list, and birdychat_messages_patch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BirdyChat?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BirdyChat in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
BirdyChat requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BirdyChat is developed by BirdyChat. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
